Software Development Task:

Please write a system called CollaborativeStoryBuilder that enables multiple users to collaboratively create and share stories in real-time. CollaborativeStoryBuilder is a web-based platform that allows users to start a story, invite friends to contribute, and build narratives together. The system supports features like real-time editing, version control, and a community gallery to showcase completed stories.
1. Implementation requirements:
   - 1. User Registration and Authentication: Users must be able to create accounts, log in, and manage their profiles. This component must be completed first to ensure secure access and user management.
   - 2. Story Creation and Editing: Users should be able to create a new story, add chapters, and edit existing content in real-time. This feature depends on the completion of the user registration and authentication to ensure that only authorized users can edit stories.
   - 3. Real-Time Collaboration: The system must support real-time collaboration, allowing multiple users to edit the same story simultaneously. This feature depends on the completion of the story creation and editing functionality to ensure a seamless user experience.
   - 4. Version Control: Implement a version control system that tracks changes, allows users to revert to previous versions, and provides a history of edits. This component depends on the real-time collaboration feature to manage changes effectively.
   - 5. Community Gallery: Create a community gallery where users can browse, rate, and comment on completed stories. This feature depends on the version control system to ensure that only the final, approved versions of stories are displayed.
   - 6. Notification System: Implement a notification system to alert users about new contributions, comments, and ratings on their stories. This feature depends on the community gallery to provide relevant notifications.


2. Project structure:
   - solution.py (main implementation)

3. Development process:
   - Developer: Create the code.
   - Developer: Revise the code.
   - Developer: Optimize the code.

If there are multiple files, please put them all in solution.py, but remember to add the file name in the following format:
```python
# file_name_1.py
# your code here

# file_name_2.py
# your code here

# file_name_3.py
# your code here
```

Please work together to complete this task following software engineering best practices.

import json
import hashlib
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from collections import defaultdict
import threading
import copy


# =============================================================================
# Data Models
# =============================================================================

@dataclass
class User:
    user_id: str
    username: str
    email: str
    password_hash: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "user_id": self.user_id,
            "username": self.username,
            "email": self.email,
            "created_at": self.created_at
        }


@dataclass
class Story:
    story_id: str
    title: str
    author_id: str
    chapters: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)  # [{"chapter_id": str, "content": str, "last_edited_by": str, "last_edited_at": str}]
    contributors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # list of user_ids
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    last_updated: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    is_completed: bool = False
    
    def to_dict(self, include_chapters: bool = True) -> Dict:
        result = {
            "story_id": self.story_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "author_id": self.author_id,
            "contributors": self.contributors,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "last_updated": self.last_updated,
            "is_completed": self.is_completed
        }
        if include_chapters:
            result["chapters"] = self.chapters
        return result


@dataclass
class Version:
    version_id: str
    story_id: str
    chapter_id: str
    content: str
    editor_id: str
    timestamp: str
    comment: str = ""
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class Comment:
    comment_id: str
    story_id: str
    user_id: str
    content: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class Notification:
    notification_id: str
    user_id: str
    type: str  # "contribution", "comment", "rating", "invite"
    story_id: str
    actor_id: str
    message: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    is_read: bool = False
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        return asdict(self)


# =============================================================================
# In-Memory Storage (Simulated Database)
# =============================================================================

class Storage:
    def __init__(self):
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.stories: Dict[str, Story] = {}
        self.versions: Dict[str, List[Version]] = defaultdict(list)  # story_id -> [Version]
        self.comments: Dict[str, List[Comment]] = defaultdict(list)  # story_id -> [Comment]
        self.notifications: Dict[str, List[Notification]] = defaultdict(list)  # user_id -> [Notification]
        self.invites: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = defaultdict(list)  # story_id -> [{inviter_id, invitee_id, timestamp}]
        self.lock = threading.RLock()


# =============================================================================
# Authentication Service
# =============================================================================

class AuthService:
    def __init__(self, storage: Storage):
        self.storage = storage
    
    def register(self, username: str, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[User]]:
        """Register a new user. Returns (success, message, user)"""
        with self.storage.lock:
            # Validate inputs
            if not username or not email or not password:
                return False, "All fields are required.", None
            if len(password) < 6:
                return False, "Password must be at least 6 characters.", None
            
            # Check for existing user
            for user in self.storage.users.values():
                if user.username == username:
                    return False, "Username already taken.", None
                if user.email == email:
                    return False, "Email already registered.", None
            
            # Create user
            user_id = secrets.token_hex(8)
            password_hash = hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
            user = User(
                user_id=user_id,
                username=username,
                email=email,
                password_hash=password_hash
            )
            self.storage.users[user_id] = user
            return True, "Registration successful.", user
    
    def login(self, username_or_email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[User]]:
        """Authenticate user. Returns (success, message, user)"""
        with self.storage.lock:
            password_hash = hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
            for user in self.storage.users.values():
                if (user.username == username_or_email or user.email == username_or_email) and \
                   user.password_hash == password_hash:
                    return True, "Login successful.", user
            return False, "Invalid credentials.", None
    
    def get_user(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[User]:
        with self.storage.lock:
            return self.storage.users.get(user_id)


# =============================================================================
# Story Service
# =============================================================================

class StoryService:
    def __init__(self, storage: Storage, auth: AuthService):
        self.storage = storage
        self.auth = auth
    
    def create_story(self, author_id: str, title: str) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[Story]]:
        """Create a new story. Returns (success, message, story)"""
        with self.storage.lock:
            author = self.storage.users.get(author_id)
            if not author:
                return False, "User not found.", None
            
            story_id = secrets.token_hex(8)
            story = Story(
                story_id=story_id,
                title=title,
                author_id=author_id,
                chapters=[{"chapter_id": "c1", "content": "", "last_edited_by": author_id, "last_edited_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()}],
                contributors=[author_id]
            )
            self.storage.stories[story_id] = story
            return True, "Story created.", story
    
    def get_story(self, story_id: str) -> Optional[Story]:
        with self.storage.lock:
            return self.storage.stories.get(story_id)
    
    def add_chapter(self, story_id: str, user_id: str) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[Story]]:
        """Add a new chapter to a story. Returns (success, message, story)"""

            }
